<td class="pl custom" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_JBAAM_CapitalStockTextBlock', window );">Capital Stock</a></td>
<td class="text"><p id="xdx_808_ecustom--CapitalStockTextBlock_z1foCSLgDRA3" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><b>Note 3. <span style="text-decoration: underline"><span id="xdx_826_z9TVCml0E5e9">Capital Stock</span></span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Preferred Stock</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">As of June 30, 2026 the Company has <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesAuthorized_c20260630_pd" title="Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized">10,000,000 </span>shares
of preferred stock, par value of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_c20260630_pd" title="Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share">0.0001</span>, authorized. Of these, <span id="xdx_902_ecustom--DesignatedShares_c20260402__20260630_zOnYK8pcQeAi" title="Designated Shares">1,000,000</span> shares have been designated as Series A Super Voting Preferred
Stock, all of which are issued and outstanding. Each share of Series A Super Voting Preferred Stock entitles the holder to <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--PreferredStockVotingRights_c20260402__20260630_z84VoqJHU9u8" title="Voting Preferred Stock">100 votes per
share</span>, voting together with the Common Stock as a single class. The shares of Series A Super Voting Preferred Stock are not convertible
and are not redeemable. The remaining <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--UndesignatedShares_c20260402__20260630_zn4u3hmxlS35" title="Undesignated Shares">9,000,000</span> shares of preferred stock remain undesignated and available for future issuance.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Common Stock</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">As of June 30, 2026 the Company has <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesAuthorized_c20260630_pd" title="Common Stock, Shares Authorized">100,000,000</span> shares
of common stock, par value of $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_c20260630_pd" title="Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share">0.0001</span>, authorized and <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesOutstanding_c20260630_pd" title="Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding"><span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_c20260630_pd" title="Common Stock, Shares, Issued">10,000,000</span></span> shares issued and outstanding. Each share of common stock entitles the
holder thereof to one vote per share. The common stock does not have cumulative voting rights.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="text-decoration: underline">Warrants</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">As of June 30, 2026, the Company has issued warrants
to Andrew Weksler, its Chief Executive Officer, to purchase up to <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightOutstanding_iI_c20260630_zuA7VkDujtHe" title="Warrants outstanding">50,000,000</span> shares of Common Stock at an exercise price $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ClassOfWarrantOrRightExercisePriceOfWarrantsOrRights1_iI_c20260630_zGrEBOdKtjhk" title="Common Stock exercise price">0.01 </span>per share.
The Warrants are exercisable at any time and expire twenty (20) years from the date of issuance. If, at the time of exercise, the shares
of Common Stock underlying the Warrants are not registered under the Securities Act, the holder may exercise the Warrants on a cashless
basis. The Warrants contain anti-dilution adjustments for stock splits, stock dividends, recapitalizations and similar events.&#160;&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"></p>
